text:
erica: Heads-up: we're planning to roll a preflight + soft-quota flow on POST /v1/embeddings tomorrow 10:00am PT. Goal: reduce tail latency for small requests and handle oversized payloads without surprising failures.

sam: By soft-quota, do you mean auto-splitting on the server or returning 413 guidance?

erica: Hybrid. Flow: 1) preflight estimate, 2) attempt server-side async split if feasible, 3) otherwise return 413 with actionable guidance. No silent dropping.

vik: Telemetry needs: preflight_estimate vs actual_tokens histogram, split_success_rate, and latency delta for prefetched requests. Tag events with route=v1/embeddings and strategy=prefetch-softquota.

jules: Console needs a compact dashboard: top row shows preflight error rate, split rate, avg latency for small/medium/large. Bottom row shows sampled problem requests (PII redacted). Also add rollout toggle to switch to strict-413 if needed.

erica: We'll add X-Embed-Units header in preflight response so SDKs can display cost. We'll accept client hints in units or bytes.

sam: Units calc question: dims-first vs bytes-first. For mixed-dimension arrays, dims-split is risky. Proposal: if all vectors share same dim -> dims-split; otherwise -> bytes-split.

vik: Add telemetry tag split_method=(dims|bytes) and client_hint=(units|bytes|none). Also log preflight_estimate and final_token_count to measure estimator bias.

jules: For 413 copy include examples and an SDK snippet. Example message: "Request exceeds soft quota. Try sending smaller batches or set X-Embed-Units hint. Docs: <link>"

erica: Adding a minimal preflight API for SDKs: POST /v1/embeddings:preflight returns a small JSON payload with estimated_units and recommended_split. Example response (in docs): {"estimated_units": 1280, "recommended_split": "3@250-dims"} embedded as a string in the docs.

sam: Runtime recombine concern: if we split server-side, can runtime preserve original ordering?

erica: Yes, runtime will stamp split_id and subseq_index so recombine is deterministic. We'll add recombine_latency_ms telemetry.

vik: Prefetch adds CPU overhead. Add opt-out header X-Embed-Prefetch: 0 for high-throughput pipelines. Measure host CPU/sec before/after rollout.

jules: Rollout plan for console wiring: staged 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with health gates (error rate, p95 latency, split failure). Provide toggle UI that maps to these stages.

erica: SRE request: implement a kill-switch route to fallback to legacy-no-prefetch variant quickly.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: embeddings-prefetch-v1 -> canary at 2026-03-31T17:00:00Z by @erica. :rocket:

vik: UX request: dashboard show 'preflight bias' = preflight_estimate / actual_tokens as a sparkline. If bias > 1.2 tighten heuristics.

sam: Also add a heatmap for per-request dimension variance; high variance => prefer bytes-split.

jules: I'll draft the Embeddings / Prefetch dashboard in staging: https://console.internal/dashboards/draft/embeddings-prefetch. Sharing with eng-platform and eng-runtime.

erica: Error responses (413) should include Retry-After and an automated chunking snippet for SDKs. Example snippet for docs: 

# naive chunker example
for i in range(0, len(vectors), chunk_size):
    resp = client.embeddings(vectors[i:i+chunk_size])

sam: I'll update SDKs to emit X-Embed-Units hints, honor X-Embed-Prefetch opt-out, and include a helper chunker.

vik: My action items: add telemetry tags, recombine_latency_ms, split_method, and run perf load for 24h.

erica: My action items: wire preflight header, add 413 copy, implement kill-switch route.

jules: My action items: dashboard draft, rollout toggle, canary health alerts.

console-bot: Draft dashboard created and shared with @jules and @erica. Permissions: eng-platform, eng-runtime.

erica: Thanks team. Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT for readiness check. :thumbsup:
